title: post api auth register success and failure cases
description: Test user registration with valid email and password, verify success response and email verification token sent. Test registration failure when EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY is missing or invalid, expect 500 error.

title: post api auth login with valid and invalid credentials
description: Test login with correct email and password, expect success and HTTP-only session cookie set. Test login with invalid credentials, expect 401 error.

title: post api auth logout invalidates session
description: Test logout with valid session cookie, expect success and session removal from database.

title: post api auth verify email with valid and invalid token
description: Test email verification with valid token, expect success. Test with invalid or expired token, expect 400 error.

title: post api auth forgot password does not reveal email existence
description: Test forgot password request with existing and non-existing email, expect success response without revealing email existence.

title: post api auth reset password with valid and invalid token
description: Test password reset with valid token and new password, expect success and invalidation of all active sessions. Test with invalid or expired token, expect 400 error.

title: get api users me with and without session cookie
description: Test retrieving authenticated user's basic info with valid session cookie, expect 200 response. Test without session cookie, expect 401 Unauthorized error.

title: get api users search with valid and invalid query
description: Test user search with query string of 3 or more characters, expect 200 with results. Test with query less than 3 characters, expect 400 error.

title: patch api profile update display name
description: Test updating authenticated user's display name with valid session and valid input, expect success. Test with invalid input, expect 400 error.

title: post api groups create with valid and invalid data
description: Test creating a new group with valid name, emoji, and description, expect success and group returned. Test with invalid body data, expect 400 error.
